title: Study Scholarships – Master Studies for All Academic Disciplines
summary: Funding for a new postgraduate or Master's programme in Germany, or a recognised study year within a Master's programme completed abroad.

degree_levels.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

subject_areas.notes: Artistic disciplines and architecture are directed to separate subject-specific DAAD scholarships; consult those routes.

institutions.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

nationality.notes: The origin-unspecified source does not establish a complete eligibility country list. Use the country-specific DAAD selection; do not infer eligibility from the dropdown.

residence.notes: Applicants resident in Germany for more than 15 months at the deadline cannot be considered.

mandatory.text: First academic degree completed by the start of funding; the most recent degree should generally be no more than six years old at the deadline.
A new programme at a state or state-recognised German university; an already-started Master's in Germany cannot be funded.
The current call funds programmes starting in winter semester 2027; funding normally begins on 1 October 2027.
Admission to the named host programme is required before funding begins; university admission and scholarship applications are separate.
Provide proof of the programme's teaching language, including when the university does not itself require it.
Do not exceed 15 months of residence in Germany at the application deadline.
For a study year within a degree abroad, the home university must recognise the credits without extending the standard study period.

exceptions.text: Degree-programme stays outside Germany normally must be essential, outside the applicant's home country and no more than one quarter of the scholarship; specified joint or double degrees may allow up to half.

funding.description: EUR 992 monthly, insurance contributions, travel allowance on application and EUR 460 annual study allowance. Conditional rent, family, disability and language support may apply. Tuition fees are not covered.
funding.duration: 10–24 months, normally the standard duration of the chosen programme, with a progress check after the first year.

application_rounds.notes: No confirmed application dates were established.

recurring_deadline_notes: Applications generally possible from 1 June to the country-specific deadline. The origin-unspecified page does not provide a current universal deadline.

required_documents.text: Motivation letter, one to three pages
Admission letter, or submission before funding starts
DAAD form identifying preferred Master's programmes, when applicable
Home-university credit recognition for a study year within a degree abroad
Current transcript and degree certificate, with the latter submitted by funding start if needed
Proof of the teaching language, normally no older than three years
German or English translations for documents in other languages

steps.text: Confirm country-specific eligibility and deadline in the DAAD database.
Apply separately for admission at the German university.
Register in the DAAD portal during the application period and request the recommendation form.
Upload and submit the complete scholarship application before the country-specific deadline.
